title: A Dual-Input Bidirectional 3-Level Battery Charger with Coarse-Fine VCF Balancing and Wide VCR for Foldable Mobile Applications
problem: Foldable mobile phones require high-density battery charging with compact passive components and support for simultaneous wired and wireless charging plus wireless power sharing (reverse direction). Existing 2-level converters suffer from size/efficiency tradeoffs.
motivation: Form-factor reduction in foldable devices drives demand for higher input-voltage efficiency and smaller magnetics to fit tight power budgets.
method: The charger uses a circuit design with three voltage levels and two separate input switches—one for plugged-in charging and one for wireless charging. When charging the battery, the circuit steps down the input voltage (called buck conversion); when the battery powers an external device, it steps up the voltage (called boost conversion); and when idle, it does nothing. The charger keeps current stable across all these modes by adjusting the switching frequency, using both coarse (rough) and fine (precise) tuning. Because the circuit handles a very wide range of input voltages, it doesn't need separate circuit designs for high or low voltage inputs—a single design works for both wired and wireless charging.
key_novelty: The circuit smoothly switches between charging and power-sharing modes without needing extra helper circuits, by using coordinated switching of the three voltage levels and automatic frequency adjustment.
contributions: Dual-input architecture supporting wired + wireless charging + bidirectional power sharing without mode gaps
Coarse-fine VCF balancing to stabilize inductor current slew rates across wide load and input ranges
Wider VCR improves efficiency at high input voltages vs. prior 2-level designs
Compact integration suitable for foldable phone power management

metrics.other: Seamless mode transition, wide input range support

limitations: Abstract-only review; no reported efficiency numbers or benchmarks provided.
primary_theme: Bidirectional multi-level charging for foldable phones
